import { type Env } from "./env.ts";
/** Largest single file a job accepts. */
export declare const MAX_FILE_BYTES: number;
export type JobStatus = "uploading" | "queued" | "rendering" | "done" | "failed";
type App = {
    Bindings: Env;
};
export declare const api: import("hono/hono-base").HonoBase<App, import("hono/types").BlankSchema, "/v1", "/v1">;
/** The campaign-relative path of a files/ URL, or undefined when it is not a safe one. */
export declare function filePath(requestPath: string, id: string): string | undefined;
export declare function jobStatus(status: InstanceStatus["status"]): JobStatus;
export {};

// ===== packages/worker/src/env.ts

import type { BrowserWorker } from "@cloudflare/puppeteer";
export interface RenderParams {
    jobId: string;
}
export interface Env {
    /** Job files under jobs/<id>/. */
    JOBS: R2Bucket;
    BROWSER: BrowserWorker;
    IMAGES: ImagesBinding;
    /** The core package's assets: themes and vendored scripts. */
    ASSETS: Fetcher;
    RENDER: Workflow<RenderParams>;
    /** Bearer token for creating, uploading and starting jobs. */
    API_TOKEN?: string;
}
/** R2 keys of a job's files. */
export declare const keys: {
    job: (id: string) => string;
    source: (id: string, path?: string) => string;
    print: (id: string, path: string) => string;
    adventure: (id: string) => string;
    pdf: (id: string) => string;
    report: (id: string) => string;
};
/** What the render workflow reports when it finishes, stored as report.json. */
export interface JobReport {
    title: string;
    pages: number;
    bytes: number;
    warnings: string[];
}

// ===== packages/worker/src/job.ts

import { type Env, type JobReport } from "./env.ts";
import { type Resolver } from "./print.ts";
export interface Assembled {
    title: string;
    assets: string[];
    warnings: string[];
}
/**
 * Turns the uploaded files into adventure.md: assembles a lorewright campaign, or takes an
 * uploaded Adventure Markdown file as it is.
 */
export declare function assembleJob(env: Env, id: string): Promise<Assembled>;
/**
 * Scales an image down to print size with Cloudflare Images. Returns a warning when that
 * fails; the original is printed then.
 */
export declare function prepareImage(env: Env, id: string, path: string): Promise<string | null>;
/**
 * Prints adventure.md: a first pass to learn on which page every heading lands, a second
 * with those numbers in the table of contents, then the page sheets (parchment and running
 * footers) that go underneath.
 */
export declare function printJob(env: Env, id: string, warnings: string[]): Promise<JobReport>;
/** Serves the print page's requests: theme assets, then the job's prepared or original files. */
export declare function resolver(env: Env, id: string): Resolver;
export declare function contentType(path: string): string;

// ===== packages/worker/src/pdf.ts

import type { AdventureMeta, OutlineEntry } from "@dndgen/core";
/** The bookmarks of a PDF, flattened in document order, and its page count. */
export declare function readOutline(bytes: Uint8Array): Promise<{
    entries: OutlineEntry[];
    pageCount: number;
}>;
/**
 * Lays the page sheets (see renderPageSheets) under the book, which was printed on a
 * transparent background: the shared background sheet under every page, then each page's
 * own footer sheet. The background is embedded once, so it is stored once. The book keeps
 * its links, bookmarks and tags because its pages stay as they are; only a content stream
 * is put in front of each.
 */
export declare function finishBook(book: Uint8Array, sheetsPdf: Uint8Array, meta: AdventureMeta): Promise<Uint8Array>;

// ===== packages/worker/src/print.ts

import { type BrowserWorker } from "@cloudflare/puppeteer";
/**
 * The origin the print page lives on. It never resolves: every request the page makes is
 * intercepted and answered by the Worker, so nothing has to be publicly reachable.
 */
export declare const ORIGIN = "https://dndgen.invalid";
/** Where the document's relative paths (its images) resolve. */
export declare const DOCUMENT_URL = "https://dndgen.invalid/doc/";
/** Where the core package's assets (themes, vendored scripts) are served. */
export declare const ASSET_URL = "https://dndgen.invalid/assets/";
/** Answers a request for a path under the origin, such as "doc/art/x.jpg" or "assets/…". */
export type Resolver = (path: string) => Promise<Response | undefined>;
export interface PrintOptions {
    /** Leave the page background transparent, so something can show through from underneath. */
    transparent?: boolean;
}
/** A Browser Rendering session that prints HTML documents to PDF. */
export declare class Printer {
    #private;
    private constructor();
    static open(binding: BrowserWorker, resolve: Resolver): Promise<Printer>;
    print(html: string, options?: PrintOptions): Promise<Uint8Array>;
    close(): Promise<void>;
}

// ===== packages/worker/src/workflow.ts

import { WorkflowEntrypoint, type WorkflowEvent, type WorkflowStep } from "cloudflare:workers";
import type { Env, JobReport, RenderParams } from "./env.ts";
/**
 * Renders one job. Each step is retried on its own, so a browser session that drops while
 * printing does not redo the assembly or the image work.
 */
export declare class RenderWorkflow extends WorkflowEntrypoint<Env, RenderParams> {
    run(event: Readonly<WorkflowEvent<RenderParams>>, step: WorkflowStep): Promise<JobReport>;
}
